您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID

fields.help_en:
The field to use for filtering. This parameter supports the following fields:

matched_host: The protected object.

cluster: The protection cluster
fields.help_zh:
执行过滤操作的字段名称，当前接口的Key只支持如下两个字段：

matched_host：防护对象。
cluster：防护集群
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: A list of filter conditions. Each item describes a filter condition
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件列表，每一个节点描述一个过滤条件
fields.name: conditions

fields.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
fields.name: end_date

fields.help_en:
The start of the time range to query, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: seconds. The query time range cannot exceed the last 30 days.

## The start time must be within the last 30 days
fields.help_zh:
查询的数据范围不超过过去30天。查询数据时使用的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
开始时间必须晚于当前时间减去30天。
-
fields.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for the query. Multiple filter conditions have a logical AND relationship
parameters.help_zh: 查询过滤条件，多个过滤条件之间是逻辑与的关系
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The metric to query. Different metrics return different data. Valid values:

qps: The number of requests that WAF processes per second. This is a peak value. WAF calculates a queries per second (QPS) value every 10 seconds and uses the peak value within the specified time granularity as the QPS.

total_requests: The total number of requests that WAF processes.

top5_status: The top five response codes that WAF returns to the client and the corresponding time series statistics.

top5_upstream_status: The top five response codes that the origin server returns to the client and the corresponding time series statistics
parameters.help_zh:
用于区分返回的数据内容，不同的Metric对应不同的数据内容，该接口支持的Metric如下：

qps: 返回waf每秒处理的请求数，采用峰值计算方法，每10秒计算出一个qps值，最后从多个值中取最大峰值作为当前统计时间粒度内的qps值。
total_requests: 返回waf处理的总请求数。
top5_status: 返回waf返回给客户端的top5响应码，以及对应的时间序列统计数据。
top 5_upstream_status: 返回源站返回给客户端的top5响应码，以及对应的时间序列统计数据
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The returned data. For a sample format, see the Examples section
schema.description_zh: 返回的数据结果，格式样例参见示例

NetworkFlowTimeSeries.description_en: The time series data. Multiple data series can be returned
NetworkFlowTimeSeries.description_zh: 返回的时间序列数据，支持返回多个值的时间序列数据

items.description_en: A single time series. The time series data consists of two arrays: Timestamps and Values. The Timestamps array contains a sequence of timestamps at fixed intervals. The Values array contains the statistical count for each interval. The two arrays have the same number of data points, and the data points correspond to each other
items.description_zh: 单个时间序列数据，时间序列数据主要包含两个数组，分别对应Timestamps和Values数组，Timestamps数组中包含了固定时间间隔的时间序列，Values数组中包含了每个固定时间间隔内的统计计数，这两个数组包含的节点个数是一样的，两者的数据点是一一对应的关系

Metric.description_en: The metric name. This value is the same as the Metric request parameter
Metric.description_zh: 返回的数据内容，跟入参中的Metric含义保持一致

Timestamps.description_en: The timestamps. Each value represents the start of a time interval
Timestamps.description_zh: 时间序列，每个点代表一个时间范围的起始时间

items.description_en: The start time of each data point. This value is a UNIX timestamp string
items.description_zh: 每个数据统计点的起始统计时间，使用UNIX时间戳字符串表示

Values.description_en: The metric values. Each value represents the count within the corresponding time interval
Values.description_zh: 数据序列，每个点代表一定时间范围内的统计计数

items.description_en: The statistical count for the current time range
items.description_zh: 当前时间范围的统计计数

TimeSeriesMetaData.description_en: The metadata of the returned data

AggregateInterval.description_en: The time granularity of each data point in the returned time series. For example, "15m" indicates that each data point represents statistics for a 15-minute interval. For more information about the time granularity, see the Time granularity of data points section
AggregateInterval.description_zh: 返回的时间序列数据中，每个数据点的统计时间粒度，比如"15m"则表示返回的每个数据点是每15分钟的统计数据。返回数据的时间粒度参见时间序列数据点时间粒度说明

DateRange.description_en: The time range that was queried
DateRange.description_zh: 查询时使用的时间范围

EndDate.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. This value is the same as the EndDate request parameter
EndDate.description_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。该值和入参数重的EndDate一致

StartDate.description_en: The start of the time range that was queried. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. This value is the same as the StartDate request parameter
StartDate.description_zh: 查询数据时使用的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。该值和入参数重的StartDate一致

Units.description_en: The unit of the returned data. Default value: requests
Units.description_zh: 返回的统计数据的单位。默认值为requests
